name: stock-market-monorepo
description: Stock Market Paper Trading Platform Monorepo

scripts.start: concurrently "npm run start -w apps/api" "npm run start -w apps/web"
scripts.build:api: npm run build -w @stock-market/shared -w @stock-market/config -w @stock-market/logger -w @stock-market/database -w @stock-market/auth -w @stock-market/market -w @stock-market/market-catalog -w @stock-market/workers -w @stock-market/portfolio -w @stock-market/orders && npm run build --prefix apps/api
scripts.build:web: npm run build -w @stock-market/shared -w @stock-market/config -w @stock-market/logger -w @stock-market/database -w @stock-market/auth -w @stock-market/market -w @stock-market/market-catalog -w @stock-market/workers -w @stock-market/portfolio -w @stock-market/orders && npm run build --prefix apps/web
